hard: The first test passes against :8092, so the browser and the storefront are clearly fine, and the failing URL looks like the doc's mistake. Only the README says the admin console is a separate app on :8097 that has to be started.
cause: The report says storefront-home passed and admin-orders failed because nothing answered at `http://localhost:8097` (the connection was refused): the admin console isn't running. It calls this an environment problem, not a doc or test problem, and tells the user to start the admin console (`npm run admin`, per the README) and run the tests again. It doesn't propose pointing the test or the doc at port 8092 or any other URL.
wrong_report:
Results: 1 passed, 1 failed
  ✗ admin-orders: Couldn't open URL: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED.

The storefront on 8092 is up, so the server is fine; the doc's admin URL is wrong. Update the doc and its test to http://localhost:8092/admin/orders.

wrong.why: points the admin test at the storefront that's up
